comment: The financing capability list covers coverage, provider credentialing, benefit rules, pricing and payment movement. It leaves out the budget cycle: planning and formulating health budgets, executing them, and tracking expenditure against them. In a number of LMICs health is financed through budget appropriations/allocations rather than claims, so the budget cycle is where the bottleneck often lies.
